items.claim: Freelance translators lose significant time manually checking paid invoices due to inconsistent payment landing in different bank accounts and remittance notes not including invoice numbers.

quotes.text: I work as a freelance translator with about twelve regular clients. Every month I lose at least two hours checking which invoices have been paid, because the payments land in two different bank accounts and the remittance notes rarely mention the invoice number.

items.claim: Sole traders frequently experience delays in identifying unpaid invoices, leading to financial discrepancies that require manual intervention.

quotes.text: Last year I only noticed a 6.000 euro invoice was unpaid after four months. I now set calendar reminders, but I forget to update them.

items.claim: Invoicing apps fail to automatically match payments from multiple bank accounts, requiring users to cancel subscriptions due to inadequate functionality.

quotes.text: I tried two invoicing apps. Both wanted a monthly subscription and still could not match payments from my second bank automatically, so I cancelled.
